basic_info.description: Perched high above the city in the iconic Crown Towers, this unit offers a rare opportunity to own a sophisticated corner residence in the heart of San Francisco. This bright and airy remodeled home is bathed in natural light from expansive windows framing sweeping city views. The thoughtful floor plan maximizes both style and function, blending timeless architectural details. The corner layout enhances privacy while capturing multiple perspectives of the city skyline, making each day feel like a postcard. Situated in one of San Francisco's most vibrant and walkable neighborhoods, The Crown Towers places you just steps from world-class dining, theater, shopping, and cultural attractions. Whether enjoying the energy of Union Square, exploring nearby Nob Hill, or simply relaxing at home surrounded by breathtaking views, this home delivers the perfect combination of location, charm, and convenience. The building offers a common roof deck with views, and a community room. Lease parking available close by. "The house is being rented unfurnished. "
